```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("class_dates.R"))

# Class-day date cell: shows "01/04" and tags it with the full date,
# so js/release-links.html knows which day each row's links belong to
class_day = function(x) {
  sprintf('<span class="class-date" data-date="%s">%s</span>', format(x, "%Y-%m-%d"), format(x, "%m/%d"))
}
```
